notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Available!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
After so long we finally managed to get the Trading Cards approved by Steam for Anime Artist 2 as well.
This is a great day, we are super happy about it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/dcb52b53dd00a57eb20ca828a043cdcb3d0d789b.png[/img]

Now features :
[i]- 5 cards  
- 5 community icons
- 3 unique backgrounds for your Steam profile[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/0f148915816c1d1ea222da432c94383c45c12e61.png[/img]

Here is an example of our new profile backgrounds, maybe we will make them a little bit brighter, what do you think?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/75ea32807ae44aea79e865c4d1d65f3c45f7b2cd.jpg[/img]

another example, this is the rare background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/529f74653c7b4beb14d0d0d0c1fce2b20159c259.jpg[/img]



Thanks for your support so far! We really appreciate it.
Now only Anime artist 3 is missing Steam Trading cards, we will work to make that happen as well. 


Ah, a little side note. Check our our newest title, a visual novel called Casina. It's a really cool game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1215740/Casina_A_Visual_Novel_set_in_Ancient_Greece/

Until the next update!

notes.title: Major Update + New DLC
notes.content:
Hello everybody,
We are back with another update and with some major news for you.
[h3]Let's jump right away into the details![/h3]


[list]
[*] [b]- Major improvements to Danya's animation system.[/b]
[i]Now Danya is more responsive and feels more alive, lip sync works better and she looks more natural while following your mouse cursor with her sight.[/i]

[*] [b]- Major adjustments to the brush tool![/b]
 [i]Using the mousewheel it's possible to adjust brush size, this feature was also avaiable in our original game Anime Artist but now it works better.[/i]

[*] [b]- We added a confirm button if someone accidentally click on the "Reset Progress" option.[/b]
[i]We really don't want to frustrate people if they accidentally clicked on the reset button.[/i]

[*] [b]- Many Bug fixes and Performance improvements[/b]
[/list]

This list is actually the sum of all the updates we made since our latest patch came out so there is no need for you to download anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/397d73bfc64b58aae57a15df6f5a8cecec1c0409.jpg[/img]

[h3]New DLC - Cutest Girsl Pack - Available![/h3]

Yeah, we asked our artist to draw new artworks for the game. He really did an amazing job and, since these girls are among my favorites, we decided to tag this DLC as the Cutest among all!
Jokes apart, if you like the work we are doing and want to support us + expand your art gallery, feel free to check this out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329780/Anime_Artist_2_Cutest_Girls_Pack/

Thanks for your support so far!
We always listen to your feedback so feel free to tell us what you think with a comment or a review.
We have also many new amazing features coming up for the future so stay tuned!

notes.title: New Update, More Art!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We are happy to be back with a new update and some very good news.
During the last couple of weeks we have been monitoring the game and listening to your feedback. This patch is actually the sum of many patches we released since release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36773148/aaae9f8ca558c6fa8029d1bbd0f33b3d3320bddb.jpg[/img]

[h3]New features requested by you:[/h3]

[b]- Gallery update!  [/b]
[i]Our gallery works better than ever! The transition when opening an image is smoother, we removed the transparent background for more immersion and increased the size of the image for a better closer look.[/i]

[b]- New Art[/b]
Danya's special artworks are now available in hot mode!!! (if the patch is installed). Now unlocking her secret artworks is more "interesting" than ever. 

[b]- Better Patch management[/b]
Our 18+ patch can be toggled on and off  directly in our Settings manu . No need to disable the entire DLC in your Steam profile.

[b]- Many bug fixes[/b]
We have solved all the issues you told us about. Just to mention some
- Stars are unlocked correctly in challenge mode
- The cursor disappearing iussue has been solved 
- Improved danya's lip sync and animations
- art unlock works as intended for "The more the better" DLC


Well that's all for now.
If you want, let us know what do you think with a comment or a review. Your feedback is really important to us!
